description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8 B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

We are looking for a highly analytical and execution\-oriented leader to drive key initiatives across risk, operations, and product. This role will focus on identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce losses, and scale systems through a combination of data\-driven insights, predictive modelling, and emerging technologies.

  

A core part of this role will include developing predictive models and leveraging AI—specifically designing and deploying agent\-based systems—to automate workflows and enhance decision\-making across the organization.

 **What you will do**

* Own and drive high\-impact initiatives across risk, underwriting, and operational workflows
* Partner cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to identify and execute on opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce losses
* Analyze large datasets to uncover trends, root causes, and actionable insights
* **Develop, validate, and deploy predictive models to inform decision\-making across risk and operational processes**
* Design and implement scalable processes and systems to support business growth
* Build business cases and quantify ROI for new initiatives and investments
* **Design, build, and deploy AI agents to automate workflows, support decision\-making, and improve operational scalability**
* Collaborate with engineering teams to productionize models, tools, and agent\-based systems
* Monitor performance of models and deployed systems, continuously iterating to improve outcomes

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 5–8\+ years of experience in analytics, data science, strategy, or operations roles
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with experience working with large datasets
* **Hands\-on experience building and deploying predictive models (e.g., risk scoring, forecasting, classification problems) in production environments**
* Experience working cross\-functionally and driving initiatives from concept to execution
* Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Experience in risk, underwriting, payments, or financial operations is a plus
* **Experience building and deploying AI agents or agentic systems (e.g., leveraging LLMs, workflow orchestration, and external data integrations)**
* Familiarity with modern data and AI tooling (Python, SQL, APIs, etc.)

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in high\-growth or startup environments
* Background in automation, process optimization, or systems design
* Experience measuring and improving operational KPIs

**Additional Information**

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. description:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

**The Opportunity**


We are seeking a Senior Technical Recruiter to serve as a high\-impact talent advisor for our expanding teams across India and Asia, and other regions as required. In this role, you are not just a recruiter; you are a regional talent architect who thrives in ambiguity and drives execution with a relentless sense of urgency. You will act as a critical liaison between global leadership and regional sites, moving beyond transactional hiring to build a proactive talent pipeline. As a self\-directed leader, you will leverage technical recruiting depth to influence Allegro’s human resources strategy, site leaders, and business partners across the semiconductor landscape.

**What You Will Do**

* Act as a strategic advisor to hiring managers, providing deep\-dive market intelligence, competitive benchmarking, and "Voice of the Candidate" insights to influence organizational design.
* Execute the end\-to\-end recruitment process with a focus on high\-complexity Analog/Digital Engineering and Technical Sales, ensuring a "One Allegro" experience from sourcing to offer negotiations.
* Develop and implement aggressive talent attraction strategies, utilizing advanced sourcing techniques and AI tools to identify and engage passive, niche talent in the semiconductor space.
* Work with global Talent Acquisition leadership to define the regional hiring roadmap, including employment branding, university relations (Intern/Campus), and site\-specific talent strategies.
* Drive data integrity and process automation within Workday, ensuring recruiting analytics are accurate, transparent, and actionable for ELT\-level reporting.
* Navigate evolving priorities and leadership transitions with a solution\-oriented mindset, maintaining momentum on critical hires despite resource or capacity constraints.

**What You Will Need**

* 7\+ years of full life cycle recruiting in a fast\-paced, high\-tech environment (Semiconductor or Electronics preferred).
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or Post\-Graduate degree in HR/Business preferred
* A proven self\-directed professional with a "consultative" approach to talent acquisition; someone who prefers building solutions over following checklists.
* Demonstrated expertise in sourcing and closing Engineers (Analog, Digital, Power) and specialized Sales professionals across the APAC region.
* The ability to think long\-term while executing with a high sense of urgency; comfortable making data\-driven decisions in the face of incomplete information.
* Exceptional ability to build trust and influence stakeholders at all levels within a distributed, global organization.
* A global mindset with deep knowledge of the India/APAC labor markets, including local compensation trends and cultural nuances.
* Proficiency with Workday ATS and a desire to leverage AI\-driven recruiting tools to improve efficiency.

**Why Allegro?**

  

Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.


We foster a culture of **Real Innovation**, empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting\-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.  

Your work will create a **Real Impact** by solving complex real\-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.  

You’ll experience **Real Connection**, collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.  

**Join us—and help build what’s next.**

title: Payroll Manager
description:
**Job Title: Payroll Manager**

**Location:** Ceres India – Bangalore

**The Ceres Commitment**


Ceres Environmental Services is a national leader in crisis management, rapid response, and disaster recovery, committed to rebuilding stronger and safer communities. Since 1976, Ceres has been awarded over $3\.2 billion in government\-funded contracts, helping people when they need it most.


Our services span emergency response, environmental services, planning, and consulting including debris removal, blue roof installation, logistics, debris management, demolition, recycling, forest management, and coastal and marine restoration. As a licensed general contractor, we bring unmatched expertise to restore stability where it’s needed most.




**Driven by Purpose, Powered by People**


At Ceres, you’re more than just an employee you’re part of a team with purpose and a meaningful mission. Whether in management, field operations, or behind the scenes, every team member plays a vital role in restoring hope and rebuilding communities.


We value initiative, respect diversity, and empower our people to lead. Our culture is built on resilience, teamwork, and accountability. If you show up with compassion, act with urgency, and deliver solutions, you’ll feel right at home. We don’t just respond to challenges we rise to them.




**Role Overview**


The Lead – Payroll is responsible for end\-to\-end US payroll operations, governance, and compliance, ensuring accurate and timely payroll delivery. This role drives operational excellence, manages audits and tax compliance, and partners closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless payroll execution and regulatory adherence.




**Key Responsibilities**

* **Payroll Operations \& Processing:**  

Manage end\-to\-end US payroll (weekly/bi\-weekly/monthly) for multiple entities, ensuring 100% accuracy and compliance with federal and state regulations.
* **Tax Compliance \& Reporting:**  

Oversee payroll taxes, deductions, filings, and year\-end reporting (W\-2, W\-2C, amendments), ensuring full compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
* **Audits, Reconciliation \& Controls:**  

Lead pre\- and post\-payroll audits, wage reconciliations, and resolve discrepancies. Support SOX controls and internal/external audits.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**  

Partner with HR, Finance, and business stakeholders to ensure accurate GL and tax reporting, and address complex payroll queries.
* **Process Improvement \& Governance:**  

Review and enhance payroll processes, implement controls, and drive continuous improvement for efficiency and compliance.
* **Regulatory \& Legislative Tracking:**  

Monitor and implement changes related to payroll laws, tax regulations, and system enhancements.
* **Team Leadership \& Development:**  

Manage, coach, and develop payroll team members while ensuring continuous training and process knowledge enhancement.




**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in finance, Accounting, Human Resources, or a related field




**Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in **US payroll operations**
* Proven experience in **managing end\-to\-end payroll, audits, and compliance**
* Hands\-on experience handling **multi\-state US payroll**




**Knowledge \& Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **US payroll laws, employment tax regulations, and compliance requirements**
* Hands\-on experience with **payroll systems** (ADP, Paycom, or similar)
* Expertise in **payroll audits, reconciliations, and discrepancy resolution**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* High attention to detail and ability to manage complex payroll scenarios




**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in **GCC / global payroll environments**
* Exposure to **SOX compliance and audit frameworks**
* Strong experience in **process improvement and automation initiatives**




**What to Expect**


As a **Lead – Payroll at Ceres India**, you will play a critical role in ensuring payroll accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence across US payroll functions. You will lead governance, audits, and process improvements while supporting a high\-impact, fast\-paced environment.


You can expect a role that requires **precision, ownership, and strong stakeholder collaboration**, where success is defined by seamless payroll execution, zero compliance gaps, and continuous process enhancement.




**Why Join Ceres?**


At Ceres, you won’t just have a job you’ll have a mission. Your work will directly impact how quickly and effectively communities recover after disasters.


We offer:

* A collaborative, mission\-driven work culture
* Opportunities for professional growth and leadership
* Exposure to U.S.\-based operations and global stakeholders
* The opportunity to make a meaningful, lasting difference in disaster recovery efforts

**Job Description**

**Job Title \-** **Instructional Design – Manager** **\- T\&O\- (S\&C GN)**

**Management Level: 7 \- Manager**

**Location: Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai**

**Must have skills:** **Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline**

**Good to have skills: Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model**

**Experience: Minimum 10 to 13 year(s) of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Any Bachelors Fulltime**

**Job Summary:**

As a Talent \& Organization (T\&O) professional in the S\&C Global Network, you’ll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. You’ll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. You’ll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, you’ll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Analyze learning needs to address the business requirements, prioritize the identified skill gaps, develop the learning and curriculum strategy, and recommend fit\-for\-purpose learning interventions that align with business needs.
* Effectively collaborate with the clients to identify the business need and propose the learning solutions that best fit the clients’ needs and build trusted advisory relationships.
* Identify opportunities to implement new and innovative learning strategies into the solution while business priorities and learning needs evolve.
* Set up the project by defining the required processes, team structure, and ways of working; create and manage workplans to mitigate risks; establish collaborative working relationships; and support successful project execution.
* Manage and mentor a team of instructional designers and media/technology designers across different locations and provide guidance for developing instructionally sound, creative and high\-quality solutions with high\-impact outcomes.
* Manage ecosystem partners for addressing learning needs, as needed.
* Manage budget, scope, timelines and effort needed to design and develop varied learning solutions across multiple programs; and align with internal and external stakeholders to manage and fulfill business expectations and commitments.
* Monitor project performance and report progress and outcomes to internal and external stakeholders and on multiple forums, as required.
* Demonstrate agility to adapt the learning solution to evolving business and audience needs, as needed.
* Contribute to the development and execution of organizational and practice initiatives.
* Contribute to business development by developing proposals for new work and building client relationships.

**Professional \& Technical Skills:**

* Education\- Graduate/Post Graduate preferable with Background in HR/Learning
* Professional Background \- Desirable \- MA/Diploma in Instructional Design or MA in Learning Sciences, MBA, PMP certification
* 10\+ years of experience in the areas of instructional design, learning delivery and learning technology
* 5\+ years of proven expertise in executing successful corporate learning programs and managing large teams
* Experience in leading and managing agile learning projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience in leading and delivering right learning solutions at the right time for enterprise\-wide technology transformation programs, leadership programs, and other behavioral skilling programs, across industry groups and functions
* Experience in working with global teams, cultures and industries
* Experience in providing consulting services to the client to facilitate the design, development, and implementation of a variety of learning solutions
* Experience in developing strong strategic business relationships to identify opportunities and turn them to projects and thereby, drive business development
* Experience in designing new\-age learning solutions and innovative application of eLearning technologies
* Be an expert in at least one niche area of learning design / technology / experience

**Additional Information:**

* Extensive knowledge of learner\-centric, performance\-based instructional theories and adult learning principles and their implementation thereof
* Deep awareness of new, upcoming and disruptive technologies impacting various industry groups and their learning needs
* Strong project management skills with proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced work environment while delivering high quality results
* Strong analytical skills and experience using and presenting data to make decisions
* Ability to work effectively in an agile, continuously evolving, and sometimes ambiguous environment
* Ability to perform comprehensive reviews of training materials, proposals and training budget, effort and staffing requirements
* Ability to build strong relations with multiple stakeholders
* Experience in using rapid development tools (e.g. Articulate Studio, Storyline, Captivate, and Camtasia) and working with learning platforms such as LMSs (e.g., Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD), SuccessFactors, SumTotal) and LXPs (e.g., Degreed, Edcast, Fuse Universal, Percipio, Area9\) is an additional advantage
* Strong analytical skills
* Structured problem solving
* Business acumen and integrated business perspective
* Effective communication in visual, oral and written forms
* Excellent interpersonal and coaching skills
* Cross\-cultural competence
* Strong program management skills
* Effective people/team management skills

title: National Program Officer or National Program Manager- Health Emergency Management
description:
Overview:

Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
  

Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
  

  

The NPO will work under the Reaching Impact, Saturation, and Epidemic Control (RISE) project in support of prevention, detection, and response to emerging infectious disease threats.
  

The two main objectives are Enhance Outbreak Containment Efforts and Improve Laboratory Confirmation
  

  

Jhpiego is seeking highly motivated National Program Officer\- Health Emergency
  

Management based in New Delhi for its RISE project. The NPO shall be responsible for support he DM Cell in building the capacity needs of PHEOC staff and key health emergency
  

management stakeholders to strengthen individual and institutional readiness for health
  

emergency response in India.  

Project overview: The two main objectives are Enhance Outbreak Containment Efforts and Improve Laboratory Confirmation
Responsibilities:

The NPO will be responsible for the following:  

1\. Capacity Building Support  

 Support the planning, coordination, and logistical management of training workshops, peer\-learning events, and other capacity\-building initiatives outlined in the programme calendar.  

 Liaise with State PHEOC Coordinators, State Health Departments, and partner organisations to ensure timely nomination of participants and operational readiness for all training activities.  

Compile, analyse, and report on training operations across PHEOCs to track programme progress and identify areas for enhancement.  

2\. Stakeholder Coordination and Partnership Management  

 Maintain regular communication and coordination with key institutional stakeholders, including NCDC, NDMA, SDMA, state health departments, and technical partners involved in PHEOC strengthening.  

 Represent the programme in DM Cell coordination meetings, inter\-agency technical working groups, and relevant review forums to ensure alignment of efforts.  

 Support the establishment and functioning of a multi\-stakeholder platform or community of practice for PHEOC professionals and health emergency managers in India.  

3\. Operationalization of Health Emergency Operation Centres  

 Work closely with state counterparts to support the systematic operationalization of Health Emergency Operation Centres, ensuring alignment with national guidelines and operational protocols.  

 Identify operational gaps, follow up on emerging challenges, and coordinate with the DM Cell and state authorities to facilitate timely resolution.  

 Strengthen data management practices within PHEOCs, including data flow processes, dashboards, and generation of actionable insights for decision\-makers.  

4\. Facilitation of Simulation Exercises  

 Design and develop tabletop exercises (TTXs), functional drills, and full\-scale simulation exercises focused on infectious disease outbreaks and other public health emergencies.  

 Lead the demonstration, coordination, and execution of simulation exercises in collaboration with state institutions and technical partners.  

 Facilitate After\-Action Reviews (AARs) to capture lessons learned, identify system gaps, and integrate insights into programme refinement.  

 Prepare detailed documentation and reports for all simulation exercises conducted across states.  

5\. Monitoring, Evaluation, and Knowledge Management  

 Develop and oversee a Monitoring and Evaluation (M\&E) framework to assess training coverage, competency enhancement, and institutional strengthening across PHEOCs.  

 Maintain and update a comprehensive training tracker, and generate periodic progress reports for the DM Cell and associated stakeholders.  

 Document best practices, success stories, and key learnings to support institutional knowledge management, programme improvement, and potential models for scale\-up  

or replication.


Required Qualifications:
* Qualifications and Experience  

	+ Master’s degree in public health, Epidemiology, Health Management, Disaster Management, or a closely related field.
	+ Minimum 10–15 years of progressively responsible experience in public health programmes in India with in\-depth understanding of public health systems
	+ Demonstrated experience in conducting training needs assessments and designing competency\-based capacity building programmes, preferably in public health emergency or health systems contexts.
	+ Working knowledge of Public Health Emergency Operations Centre (PHEOC) functions, Emergency Operations Centre (EOC) management, and/or Incident Command/Management Systems (ICS/IMS).
	+ Familiarity with national and international frameworks relevant to health security: IHR (2005\), NAPHS, Sendai Framework, WHO Health Emergency and Disaster Risk Management (Health EDRM) Framework.
	+ Strong facilitation, communication, and report\-writing skills in English Desirable
	+ Prior experience working with or within Government of India health emergency management structures (NCDC, NDMA, MoHFW, State Disaster Management Authorities or any technical agencies).
	+ Exposure to simulation exercise design and facilitation (tabletop, functional, or fullscale exercises) in public health or emergency management settings.
	+ Knowledge of e\-learning platform development and blended learning methodologies.
	+ Experience working within UN, bilateral donor, or international NGO programme environments.
Skills and Competencies  

 Demonstrated ability to multitask and work in a multicultural  

 Ability to produce documents and coordinate activities independently  

 Ability to handle a variety of assignments under pressure of deadlines  

 Excellent organizational skills required  

 Ability to work effectively as part of a team and with diverse stakeholders.  

 Demonstrated analytical skills for data collection and reporting.  

 Proficiency in using technology for communication and data management. Proficiency in computer skills particularly MS Office  

 Excellent English, Hindi and/or local language communication skills  

 Demonstrated skills on communications and knowledge management  

 Willingness and flexibility to work on a wide range of tasks
* Jhpiego is an equal opportunity employer and offers highly dynamic and enabling work environment.  

Jhpiego offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive employee benefits package. Women candidates will be preferred.

At the Esri R\&D Center\-New Delhi, we are building industry\-leading software to make maps, geographic information, and analyses available on any device, anywhere, at any time.

* Ability to organize work and meet deadlines while faced with many interruptions and competing priorities
* Excellent time management skills and ability to multi\-task and follow\-up on multiple projects
* Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite and comfort with a variety of online systems
* Strict attention to detail including the ability to maintain a high level of accuracy in preparing and reviewing accounting information
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant field of study
* Existing work authorization for India

* Minimum typing speed of 45 wpm
* Executive Assistant experience preferably in a software/ IT company

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition (Hyderbad)
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
Our Values**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. **INTRODUCTION:**
The Manager, Talent Acquisition will be responsible for planning, developing, and implementing an effective talent acquisition strategy for ABC Fitness. This position works closely with stakeholders, hiring managers, and applicable HR Business Partners to ensure that ABC recruitment efforts align with company needs and objectives. As the first impression for ABC, the Manager, Talent Acquisition serves as an employer brand ambassador and is responsible for leading recruitment efforts to attract top talent that will shape the future of ABC Fitness. **This role requires working from our Hyderabad office 2–3x per week.****WHAT YOU’LL DO:*** Lead company recruiting efforts internally and externally on a local, national, and global level to attract world\-class talent from sourcing through onboarding
* Manage competing priorities while effectively working across multiple time zones
* Partner with global stakeholders and teams to align hiring strategies and execution
* Balance strong relationship management with operational excellence
* Drive ongoing operational improvements and efficiencies
* Perform analysis of headcount forecasting, sourcing strategy creation, and continuous process improvement
* Create and report on recruitment metrics; manage reporting tools and dashboard data
* Develop and enhance the end\-to\-end candidate experience
* Oversee management of all staffing sources, including contractor vendors
* Build deep understanding of each business unit’s hiring needs, enabling their vision through a focus on speed, quality, and experience
* Support the development and maintenance of the company’s employer brand
* Create both passive and proactive sourcing and recruiting strategies
* Partner with RPO and support management of the internal recruiting team, including global recruiters
* Support executive\-level recruitment efforts as needed
* Actively manage and work on requisitions to support evolving business needs
* Support additional talent\-related projects as needed

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED:*** Ability to work from the Hyderabad office 2–3x per week
* **Must be able to work across multiple time zones, including IST evening hours as required**
* **Proven experience working with and leading global teams**
* Minimum 10\+ years of overall experience in talent acquisition, with 8\+ years of people management experience
* Experience leading and managing recruiting teams in a global environment
* Comfortable interfacing with stakeholders at all levels (internally and externally)
* Engaging, dynamic, and comfortable being highly visible and proactive
* Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills
* Ability to recruit and source at all levels of the organization
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail
* Highly responsive with a positive attitude and ability to motivate others
* Flexibility and adaptability in a fast\-changing environment
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Experience with applicant tracking systems (Workday preferred)
* Knowledge of employment laws and hiring practices
* Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (preferred)
* Social media and employer branding experience
* Strong recruiting data and analytics expertise
* Experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to enhance recruiting processes, sourcing strategies, and operational efficiency
* Understanding of People \& Culture practices

 **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:*** Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. \#oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee \+ spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent\-in\-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers


At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**.
About ABC Fitness
ABC Fitness is the \#1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data\-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

description:
**Additional Information**  

**Job Number**26040368  

**Job Category**Human Resources

**Schedule**Full Time

**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

  



As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  



**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.


* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.


* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.


* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.


* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.


* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.


* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.


* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

  



**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.

  



**Managing Employee Development**


* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on\-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.


* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.


* Represents Human Resources at the property Safety Committee; helps to identify ways to create awareness of the importance of safety in the workplace and decrease accident frequency and severity.


* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.


* Oversees the selection/non\-selection and offers processes to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non\-selection and applicants receive status notifications).

title: Technical Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Title: Technical Project Coordinator**

**Location**: Gomti Nagar, Lucknow

**Employment Type**: Full\-Time

**Experience**: 1–3 years (preferably in a tech/software environment)

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly organised and detail\-oriented **Technical Project Coordinator** to bridge the gap between clients and our development team. You will be responsible for gathering client requirements, facilitating smooth communication between stakeholders, ensuring proper documentation, coordinating project tasks, testing deliverables, and managing post\-delivery client interactions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Requirement Gathering \& Analysis**

* Conduct client meetings to understand their business requirements.
* Document technical and functional requirements clearly and comprehensively.
* Translate client needs into actionable tasks for the development team.

**Team Coordination \& Facilitation**

* Act as a communication bridge between clients and developers.
* Provide the development team with all necessary resources—access credentials, API keys, SDKs, mockups, etc.
* Share detailed error logs, screenshots, or video recordings with relevant team members for faster resolution.
* Clarify any ambiguities raised by the technical team regarding features or requirements.

**Testing \& Quality Assurance**

* Perform UAT (User Acceptance Testing) for all completed modules before client handover.
* Ensure that all deliverables align with initial requirements and are free from critical bugs.
* Maintain a checklist or testing document for each project milestone.

**Client Support \& Enhancements**

* Coordinate with clients post\-deployment for issues, bug reports, or enhancement requests.
* Collect, document, and prioritise change requests and forward them to the development team.
* Ensure timely resolution and communicate progress with clients clearly and professionally.

**Project Tracking \& Reporting**

* Maintain project timelines and ensure deliverables are met as per schedule.
* Use project management tools like Trello, Asana, or Jira to track progress.
* Provide regular status updates to internal teams and clients.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* Proven experience in client communication and technical coordination.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Familiarity with bug tracking and QA/testing processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of APIs, Web/Mobile app workflows.
* Experience with tools like Figma, Canva, Postman, Jira, Notion, or similar.
* Basic testing skills and experience writing test cases and writing build release notes.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with a fast\-growing tech company delivering impactful software solutions.
* Be the voice of the client inside the tech team and ensure project excellence.
* Opportunity to grow into a Project Lead or Manager role based on performance.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹120,000\.00 \- ₹180,000\.00 per year

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Support Technical Engineer
description:
Support Technical Engineer responsible for configuration, troubleshooting, maintenance, and day\-to\-day support of IoT devices and related systems. Ensures smooth device operations, timely issue resolution, and coordination with internal teams and clients.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Configure and deploy IoT devices as per project requirements
* Perform device installation, testing, and commissioning at site or remotely
* Monitor device performance and ensure continuous connectivity
* Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, firmware, and network\-related issues
* Work on Linux\-based systems for device access, configuration, and debugging (basic level)
* Access devices via SSH and perform basic command\-line operations where required
* Maintain logs of issues, resolutions, and daily activities
* Provide technical support to clients via call, email, or remote access
* Coordinate with development team for bug fixes and improvements
* Handle SIM/network configuration, IP settings, and server connectivity
* Perform firmware upgrades and device health checks periodically
* Maintain inventory records of devices, accessories, and spares
* Assist in documentation, SOP (Standard Operating Procedures), and reports

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Operations Manager — AI\-Powered** Chess Gaja · Madurai · Full\-time ₹28,000 \- 30,000/month \| Monday–Saturday \| 9:00 AM–6:00 PM \| In\-person only

**About Chess Gaja**

Chess Gaja is a global online chess academy serving students across 40\+ countries, with approximately 175 active students and a lean team of 9\. Our Madurai office is where strategy is made. We need one more person in this room — someone who runs operations end\-to\-end, solo, without being told what to do next.

**What This Role Actually Is**

You are not a coordinator. You are not an assistant. You are the person who makes sure the business runs — every day, without gaps. The founders focus on growth and product. You own everything operational.

If a parent in the US flags a billing error on a Friday evening, you fix it before Monday. If a remote team member goes quiet, you notice before the founders do. If a process is broken, you document and repair it — unprompted.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Zoho One ownership** — CRM, LMS, and Desk. You manage the data, the workflows, and the reports. If it's not in Zoho, it didn't happen.
* **Global billing and revenue protection** — Track renewals, resolve payment issues across 40\+ countries, and ensure zero revenue leakage every billing cycle.
* **Remote team accountability** — Be the operational hub between the Madurai office and 7 remote team members. Decisions made in this room must become results — fast.
* **International client communication** — Manage professional correspondence with parents across the US, Europe, and Asia. Written English must be polished and professional.
* **SOP documentation and process improvement** — Build the operating manual for Chess Gaja. If a process exists only in someone's head, your job is to put it on paper and make it repeatable.
* **Lead conversion and student onboarding** — High\-intent leads filtered by our chatbot system arrive directly to you on WhatsApp. Using structured templates and good judgment, you convert warm enquiries into enrolled students and ensure a smooth onboarding experience. This is consultative, not pushy — the lead is already interested, your job is to close the gap.

**The Non\-Negotiables**

* **You use AI tools daily.** ChatGPT, Claude, or similar — not as experiments, but as actual work tools. If you are not already doing this, this role is not for you.
* **You work independently.** There is no manager checking your task list. You identify what needs to be done, you do it, and you flag only what genuinely needs a decision.
* **You are technology\-comfortable.** CRM systems, Google Sheets, WhatsApp automation, payment gateways — you either know these or you figure them out quickly.
* **4\-6 years of real operations experience.** Fresher applicants will not be considered. We need someone who has already made mistakes elsewhere and learned from them.
* **You are a confident, clear communicator in writing.** A significant part of this role is converting warm international leads over WhatsApp. You don't need a sales background — but you must be able to read a conversation, respond with the right template at the right moment, and know when to go off\-script.
* **Based in Madurai, long\-term.** This is not a remote role. You must be here, in person, Monday to Saturday.
* You must bring your own laptop and smartphone to work daily. This is a condition of employment, not a preference.

**What Makes You Stand Out**

These are not required — but candidates who have them will move to the top of our list:

* Prior experience in an edtech company in any operational, administrative, or coordination role
* Basic knowledge of chess — you don't need to play competitively, but understanding the world we operate in helps you serve our families better
* Familiarity with Zoho One, specifically CRM
* Experience managing international clients or cross\-timezone communication

**Who We Expect to Apply**

Professionals returning to Madurai from Chennai or Bangalore who want the intensity of a startup without relocating again. Local high\-achievers who are under\-utilised in their current role and want real ownership of a global operation.

In today's market — where AI is replacing execution\-only roles — this is the kind of role that builds skills that remain valuable. You will learn how a global digital business actually runs, sitting next to the people who built it.

**Important Terms**

* 3\-month probation period applies upon joining
* Post\-probation: 2\-month notice period required for resignation
* Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM, in\-person at our Madurai office
* Immediate joiners preferred

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹28,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Gomathipuram, Madurai, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you play Chess? If yes, please provide your Chess.com/Lichess username and current rating. (Type 'No' if you don't play)
* This role requires you to be in our Madurai office Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM, with your own laptop and smartphone, starting immediately. Confirm you meet all three conditions. Type Yes or No — do not explain.
* Name every AI tool you used in the last 7 days and describe one specific task you completed using it
* A parent says, 'Another academy is offering classes for 30% less.' Write a 3\-sentence WhatsApp response that defends our value without being defensive or 'pushy'.
* Describe one work problem you identified and fixed on your own — without being asked by anyone. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the result?

title: Team Member -Employee Relations- Kolkata
description:
**Job Summary**
 The HR \- ER Compliance Manager – Zonal will be responsible for Employee Relations and compliance across assigned branches within the zone for the Gold Loans business. The role ensures adherence to statutory labour laws, company policies, audit requirements, and ethical HR practices. The incumbent must be comfortable with frequent travel to branches for audits, investigations, and compliance monitoring.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:** 
**1\. HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure 100% statutory compliance across branches (Shops \& Establishment Act, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, PF, ESI, CLRA, POSH, etc.).
* Conduct periodic HR compliance audits across branches.
* Maintain updated compliance trackers and documentation.
* Coordinate with legal and compliance teams for statutory filings and inspections.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR and labour compliance.


**2\. Employee Relations (ER)**
* Manage employee grievance handling and resolution within defined timelines.
* Conduct disciplinary inquiries and domestic investigations where required.
* Support HRBP in handling misconduct, absenteeism, and performance issues.
* Ensure proper documentation of warning letters, charge sheets, and termination processes.
* Promote a positive employee relations climate across the zone.
* Monitor adherence to code of conduct and ethical standards.
* Partner with Business HR to address Employee issues.
* Oversee background verification and employee documentation.


**3\. POSH \& Workplace Conduct**
* Ensure compliance with POSH regulations across branches.
* Support IC inquiries and conduct awareness sessions.


**4\. Travel \& Field Engagement**
* Conduct regular branch visits across the assigned zone.
* Perform surprise compliance checks and employee engagement meetings.
* Be available for urgent ER matters and statutory inspections.


**Key Skills \& Competencies:**
* Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in Employee Relations and disciplinary processes.
* Investigation and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong documentation and audit management skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the zone.

title: HR & People Operations Generalist
description:
**HR \& People Operations Generalist** 




  





**Location:** 




 India (Remote) – Preference for candidates located in
 **Bangalore or other major HR hubs such as Hyderabad, Pune, or Mumbai** 




  





*\*\*We are looking for someone who can start ASAP, ideally no more than 45 day notice* 




  





**About LevelUP** 




 LevelUP is a global talent and consulting organization partnering with leading companies to deliver high\-impact talent solutions. With teams across North America, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC, we focus on building high\-performing teams and creating an exceptional employee experience grounded in our core values of
 **Drive, Collaboration, and Trust** 
 .
 



  





 As we continue to expand our global footprint, we are establishing our
 **India entity** 
 and building the foundational People \& Culture infrastructure to support our growing team in the region.
 



  





**Role Overview**




 The
 **HR \& People Operations Generalist – India** 
 will serve as the local People \& Culture partner for LevelUP’s India entity.
 



 The role will work closely with the
 **Global People \& Culture team, Global Payroll Manager, LevelUP’s PEO partner supporting global payroll and HR operations, and external partners including benefits providers** 
 to maintain compliant HR operations in India. Payroll processing and core HR systems administration are managed centrally through the PEO platform, and this role will support local compliance, employee experience, and HR program implementation.
 



 In addition, this role plays an important part in reinforcing LevelUP’s culture and helping foster a positive employee experience for our India team.
 



  





 As LevelUP operates with a
 **fully remote workforce in India** 
 , this role requires strong knowledge of
 **state\-specific employment laws and statutory requirements** 
 that may impact compensation structures, statutory benefits, and employment practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**HR Compliance \& Employment Law** 



* Ensure compliance with
 **Indian labor laws and statutory requirements** 
 across relevant states.
* Monitor and advise on
 **state\-specific regulatory requirements** 
 that may affect employment terms, statutory benefits, and employment practices.
* Maintain awareness of updates to Indian employment legislation and advise the Global People \& Culture team accordingly.
* Support the review of
 **compensation structures** 
 to ensure alignment with Indian wage regulations and statutory contribution requirements.
* Support the
 **localization of global HR policies and programs** 
 to ensure alignment with Indian labor laws and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain compliant employee documentation and statutory employment records.



  





**Statutory Benefits \& Compliance Administration** 



* Support administration of statutory programs including:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Professional Tax (where applicable)
* Labour Welfare Fund (where applicable)
* Gratuity
* Maternity Benefit Act and other statutory leave requirements
* Support the
 **administration and ongoing compliance of Provident Fund (PF)** 
 contributions, including coordination with payroll and maintaining required documentation. Familiarity with
 **EPFO reporting processes and contribution requirements** 
 is preferred.
* Partner with the
 **Global Payroll Manager** 
 to ensure statutory contributions are accurately administered through payroll.
* Assist with documentation and compliance requirements associated with statutory programs.
* Coordinate with
 **LevelUP’s benefits broker** 
 and the global People \& Culture team to support administration of employee benefit programs in India.



  





**Payroll \& HR Operations Coordination** 



* Partner with the
 **Global Payroll Manager and LevelUP’s PEO partner** 
 to support payroll operations for India employees.
* Coordinate with the
 **PEO partner on HR administration and employee lifecycle processes** 
 , including onboarding, offboarding, and employment documentation.
* Validate payroll inputs and flag compliance considerations or statutory requirements.
* Assist with employee communication regarding payroll, statutory deductions, and benefits.



  





**Employee Lifecycle Support** 



* Partner with the Global People \& Culture team to support
 **onboarding and offboarding processes administered through the PEO platform** 
 .
* Maintain employee records and employment documentation.
* Support the preparation, review, and maintenance of
 **employment agreements, contract documentation, and employee records** 
 .
* Assist with the
 **localization and administration of employee policies and handbook provisions** 
 applicable to employees in India.
* Help ensure employment documentation and policies remain aligned with
 **Indian labor law and statutory requirements** 
 .
* Provide HR guidance to employees and managers regarding HR policies, employment terms, and workplace practices.
* Support probation management, employment confirmations, and contract documentation.



  





**People \& Culture Initiatives** 



* Partner with the Global People \& Culture team to support the rollout of
 **employee engagement and culture initiatives** 
 within India.
* Help reinforce LevelUP’s core values of
 **Drive, Collaboration, and Trust** 
 through local People \& Culture programs.
* Support the implementation of global programs related to:
* performance management
* employee engagement and feedback initiatives
* career development programs
* **Collaborate with the Learning \& Development (L\&D) team** 
 to coordinate training initiatives and development programs for employees in India.
* Provide local insights and feedback to ensure global People \& Culture programs are relevant and effective for employees in India.
* Support internal communications and engagement initiatives that strengthen connection within a
 **remote workforce environment** 
 .
* Assist in building and scaling People \& Culture processes and policies as the LevelUP India entity grows.



  





**POSH Compliance \& Workplace Governance** 



* Support the implementation and administration of the
 **POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) framework** 
 .
* Assist with establishing and administering the
 **Internal Committee (IC)** 
 when required by law.
* Ensure appropriate POSH policy awareness and training requirements are supported.



  





**HR Audits \& Regulatory Readiness** 



* Support HR compliance reviews and regulatory audits as required.
* Maintain documentation required for statutory inspections or labor authority inquiries.
* Assist with preparation of documentation required for statutory filings or regulatory reviews.



  





**Qualifications**



* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **7\-10 years of HR generalist experience in India** 
 within a multinational or global organization.
* Strong knowledge of
 **Indian labor laws, statutory benefits, and employment regulations** 
 .
* Exposure to employment regulations for other Asian countries.
* Understanding of
 **state\-specific employment regulations in India** 
 , including how variations in state laws may impact statutory contributions, compensation structures, and employment practices.
* Experience supporting
 **employment contracts, HR policies, and employee handbook documentation** 
 within India.
* Practical experience supporting
 **statutory compliance programs such as Provident Fund (PF), gratuity, and other required employee benefit programs** 
 .
* Experience supporting payroll coordination and statutory benefits administration.
* Experience supporting
 **remote or distributed workforces across multiple Indian states** 
 .
* Experience working within
 **multinational or globally distributed organizations** 
 , supporting alignment between global policies and local employment regulations.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a globally distributed organization.



**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience supporting
 **new entity setup or early\-stage HR operations** 
 in India.
* Experience working with
 **global HR teams and international organizations** 
 .
* Familiarity with HR or payroll platforms such as
 **Deel, ADP, or similar systems** 
 .

title: Manager- Human Resource Business Partner
description:
A career in Human Resources, within Internal Firm Services, will provide you with the opportunity to make a difference at PwC by helping to fully leverage the skills and talents of all our people. You’ll focus on helping the local offices in driving the Firm’s people strategy, creating a unique people experience for each individual, and supporting our Firm wide values by working with the core competencies that measure and drive individual and Firm wide success in the marketplace. Our team helps bridge the relationship between leadership and employees at PwC through Human Resources solutions. You’ll handle issues on operation management, strategic partnership, employee relations and emergency responding.
   

  

 To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each and every one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose\-led and values\-driven leader at every level. To help us achieve this we have the PwC Professional; our global leadership development framework. It gives us a single set of expectations across our lines, geographies and career paths, and provides transparency on the skills we need as individuals to be successful and progress in our careers, now and in the future.
   

  

 As a Manager, You'll Work As Part Of a Team Of Problem Solvers, Helping To Solve Complex Business Issues From Strategy To Execution. PwC Professional Skills And Responsibilities For This Management Level Include But Are Not Limited To:

title: Process Associate- Fresher
description:
**Job Title:** Process Associate (Fresher)  

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  

**Company:** Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd.

**About Us**
------------


Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to transforming the healthcare industry. We take pride in being a reliable Healthcare Management partner. With several years of experience, we have perfected our end\-to\-end services in medical billing, A.R. management, and other essential healthcare operations.


We provide services to Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US\-based Healthcare Company. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and continuous growth drives our success. As we expand, we are seeking enthusiastic and responsible **freshers** to join our team as Process Associates.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The Process Associate (Fresher) will support employee attendance tracking, workplace monitoring, and operational documentation. This is an entry\-level role suitable for candidates who are willing to learn, follow company policies, and work closely with HR, IT, and Security teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Attendance Monitoring**

* Assist in tracking daily employee attendance.
* Support verification of punctuality, absences, and late arrivals.
* Help generate daily, weekly, and monthly attendance reports.
* Share reports with HR and management teams.

### **CCTV \& Surveillance Support**

* Assist in monitoring CCTV systems to ensure workplace safety.
* Report suspicious activities or issues to the concerned team.
* Maintain basic logs of surveillance recordings.

### **Login/Logout Monitoring**

* Support tracking of employee login and logout times.
* Maintain shift\-wise working hour records.
* Identify basic discrepancies and report them to HR.

### **Alarm \& Access Control Support**

* Assist in maintaining alarm system codes and access permissions.
* Update access lists under supervision.
* Follow security procedures as per company policy.

### **Operational Support**

* Assist HR and Operations teams with attendance\-related tasks.
* Maintain records related to attendance and employee logs.
* Support onboarding activities such as system access setup.
* Assist during audits when required.

### **Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain organized records of attendance and login/logout data.
* Prepare reports under supervision.
* Provide required documents during internal reviews.

### **Support \& Coordination**

* Coordinate with HR, IT, and Security teams as needed.
* Provide support to employees regarding attendance queries.
* Follow instructions from supervisors and management.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Mandatory)**
* **Freshers are welcome to apply**
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, MS Word)
* Good communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Willingness to learn and work in night shifts
* High level of integrity and confidentiality

**Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion**
--------------------------------------


Diversity, equality, and inclusion are fundamental to our success at HUMS. We actively promote diversity across all aspects of our organization and foster an inclusive culture where everyone has equal opportunities to grow and succeed.

**Work Schedule \& Benefits**
-----------------------------

* Competitive salary (including EPF and ESIC)
* Health insurance
* Four\-day work week (Monday – Thursday)
* Opportunities for career growth and professional development
* Food and cab\-drop facilities available
* **Night Shift:** 4:45 PM to 3:45 AM
* **Work Mode:** Work From Office only

**Application Process**
-----------------------


Please submit your resume detailing your academic background and interest in this role.


For any queries, please contact:  

 recruitment@hupcfl.com  

 7780502143

**Note:** Candidates are requested to contact between **4:45 PM to 3:45 AM IST, Monday through Thursday.**

**Position Title:** 
 Talent Acquisition Executive – IT \& Technical Hiring (India\- Hyderabad\- Remote)
 



**Reporting To:** 
 TAG Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Office\-based (Hyderabad preferred); other major metros considered based on project alignment)
 



**Experience Required:** 
 2 – 7 years (relevant hands\-on experience in IT/Technical recruitment end to end Hands on)
 



**Shift:** 
 Aligned to business needs (may include 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM or flexible office hours as per active project requirements).
 



**Notice Period:** 
 Immediate to 30 days preferred
 



**Role Overview** 




 Prudent Globaltech Solutions Pvt Ltd is looking for Talent Acquisition Executives
 
 to support our IT and technical hiring needs, especially for cutting\-edge tech for full\-scale development, backend modernization initiatives, DevSecOps practices, and Cybersecurity product lines.
 



  





 Your primary responsibility is to build a strong pipeline of skilled technical talent that aligns with our requirements — including proficiency in
 **Frontend/Backend** 
 , Data Science / Data Engineering \-
 **Golang** 
 for cloud\-native services,
 **Docker/Kubernetes** 
 ,
 **secure API development, and DevSecOps, Cisco/Splunk, Palantir, and other support services. You will work closely with hiring managers, architects, and project leads to ensure you attract candidates who can deliver responsive UIs, migrate legacy systems to modern Go microservices, and operate effectively in zero\-trust, security\-sensitive environments.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Partner with hiring managers and technical architects to understand detailed role specifications, skill requirements, and project timelines.
* Develop and execute end\-to\-end recruitment strategies — from sourcing to onboarding — with a strong focus on quality, diversity, and speed of hire.
* Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn), social media, employee referrals, Boolean search, and networking in Tier\-1 and Tier\-2 cities.
* Screen resumes, conduct preliminary technical discussions, coordinate interviews with architects and stakeholders, and manage offer negotiations while ensuring competitive yet prudent compensation structures.
* Build and maintain a robust talent pipeline for critical skills.
* Ensure candidate experience remains positive and professional, while embedding security and compliance awareness during the hiring process.
* **Track recruitment metrics (time\-to\-hire, offer acceptance, and quality of hire** 
 ) and provide regular dashboards to leadership.
* Support internal mobility, fresher hiring programs, and campus connect initiatives where required.
* Stay updated on market salary trends, skill availability, and competitor hiring practices in the Indian IT landscape.



**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 3–7 years of proven experience in
 **IT/Technical Talent Acquisition** 
 , preferably in product/services companies.
* Strong understanding of technical skills: HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript, Angular framework, TypeScript, Bootstrap, RESTful services, Golang basics or backend concepts, Docker/K8s, DevSecOps principles.
* Hands\-on experience with ATS systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, and advanced sourcing techniques.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team, in a fast\-paced Agile environment.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel (for reporting), and HR tools.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* MBA in HR or equivalent postgraduate degree.
* **Certification in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment Analytics, or AI\-powered hiring tools.**
* Prior experience in Healthcare/IT services or companies with strict security and on\-site mandates.
* Knowledge of current 2026 trends: skills\-first hiring, AI\-assisted screening, and focus on mid\-level talent with practical project experience.



**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary aligned with market standards for similar roles in India, depending on experience and location, with performance incentives.
* Opportunity to work on high\-impact hiring that directly supports our Angular \+ Golang modernization efforts and client projects.

 Office\-based role with necessary infrastructure and shift flexibility as per active project demands.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Engineer, the Networks tower manages globally the life cycle, delivery, quality and performance of the Wide Area Network, the internet connections, network management, Firewall, Security, (W)LAN, DNS/DHCP and all other aspects of connectivity for Nokia Networks offices and partners. Support the digital transformation and the use of cloud services. Responsible for IT service management handling Incident management, Problem management, Change management for all IT network technologies. Work on technical design, functionality, configuration, performance and quality of connectivity. This is a position in network service delivery for enabling reliable service delivery for IT network services.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Follow troubleshooting mechanisms stated in SOPs and suggest corrective action or capture logs
* Work in 24x7 support model and provide required shift handover
* Create incident ticket for device alerts for non\-auto\-ticketing alerts, triage and escalate
* Execute low critical service requests based on the SOPs
* Own incident ticket resolution end\-to\-end and co\-ordinations
* Coordinate with cross\-functional technology technical team to resolve the incident
* Track intermediate issue until its closure working with multiple stakeholder
* Follow the problem mgmt. process to get the root cause and problem task closure
* Engage WAN service provider/Vendor/TAC to troubleshoot the issue and escalate to get is resolved
* Additional duties as required and possible remote implementation assistance on special projects
* Helping in ticket management and reporting task
* Hands \& eye support co\-ordination and vendor dispatch


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-Have:**
* Bachelor's degree or engineering degree in Telecommunications/Information Technology/Computer Science or equivalent
* Good understanding of network technologies: TCP/IP, VRRP, DNS, ARP, STP, Trunking, Port Channeling, VRF, IPsec, and TLS
* Familiar with routing protocols such as OSPF, ISIS, BGP, Route Policy, QoS, VRRP, Multicast, LDP, and MPLS
* Knowledge in all network productions router, switches and Firewall..etc
* Must have a strong understanding on the basics of network communication like TCP/IP
* Sound knowledge of IP addressing, DHCP \& DNS, various routing \& switching protocols like OSPF, BGP, VRRP, STP etc.
* Sound knowledge of various WAN connectivity models like SDWAN, MPLS, Point to Point etc, wireless communications and its components like access points and controllers
* Sound knowledge of security protocols and concepts like IPsec, SSL VPN, ACL, NAT etc, at least one of the public cloud concepts from Azure, GCP, AWS etc.
* Must have an anything automate attitude \& the required skillset to understand the technical requirements and develop network automation for various deployments and strong presentation skill in documenting the high\-level and low\-level network design

* Ability to coordinate with cross\-functional technical team \& stake holder management in getting our tasks achieved and engage with Customers, Partners, Vendors \& service provider wherever needed

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Your IT Future, Delivered.
   

  

 Senior Network Engineer (NOC)
   

  

 With a global team of 5600\+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned the \#GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.
   

  

**Digitalization. Simply delivered.**
 At IT Services, we are passionate about network technology. Our Network Operations Center team is continuously expanding. No matter your level of your proficiency, you can always grow within our diverse environment.
   

  

*\#DHL \#DHLITServices \#GreatPlace*
**Grow together.**
 As a Senior Network Engineer in DHL India Telecom Team, you will play a critical role in maintaining the stability and performance of DHL’s network infrastructure spread across multiple business units in India. Your primary responsibility is to monitor, identify, and escalate issues affecting business\-critical services across technologies such as LAN, WAN \& Wireless LAN.
   

  

 In addition to operational duties, you will contribute to service improvement by analyzing recurring issues and providing feedback and recommendations to help optimize network performance, reduce operational risk, and enhance overall service delivery. This includes identifying patterns, proposing configuration improvements, and collaborating with engineering and architecture teams. You will also mentor junior engineers and support knowledge sharing within the team.
   

  

 This position requires a blend of deep technical knowledge, strong analytical thinking, and effective communication skills. You will work closely with global teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure that DHL’s network infrastructure remains robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs.
   

  

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what you will do**
* Lead and coordinate incident resolution for Telecom infrastructure.
* Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for LAN, WAN (SDWAN, MPLS) \& WLAN.
* Provide interim and permanent solutions for business\-critical incidents.
* Analyze incident trends and network capacity for proactive planning.
* Participate in change management processes.
* Monitor and resolve infrastructure events impacting service quality.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers.
* Demonstrate ownership and accountability in all assigned tasks.
* Responsible for documentation and updating internal processes within the team.


**What you should have:**
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* 10 years of hands\-on experience in Telecoms or Network Operations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Fluent in English (spoken and written).
* CCNP Network Certification.
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, Cisco switching/routing, and wireless LAN.
* Familiarity with firewall (FW), intrusion prevention (NIPS), F5 load balancing and Proxy.
* Excellent communication, prioritization, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* ITIL Foundation.


**An array of benefits for you:**
* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in\-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self \+ Spouse \+ 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent \-in\-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

* Introduces the team to new technologies, frameworks, and points of view


**Our Tech Stack**
* Java/JUnit
* XpressO (Workday proprietary)


**About You**
 Are you passionate about Web APIs? Are you interested in building the future framework to support Workday's SOAP and REST offerings? Do you consider yourself an advocate on the subject of Web APIs? Then you sound like an ideal candidate to apply to our role with the Workday Web Services Frameworks team!
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**

**Other Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a computer related field or equivalent work experience


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 At Workday, we are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience where all candidates can fully demonstrate their skills. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point, please email accommodations@workday.com.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

 ● Collaborate with and assist fellow members of the Data Research Engineering Team as required.

 Core Skills:
